name: Cormorant
overview: The cormorant is identified in Scripture as a bird that is forbidden to be eaten, as noted in Leviticus 11:17 and Deuteronomy 14:17. It is also associated with desolation and judgment, inhabiting ruined places alongside other creatures like the bittern and owl, as described in Isaiah 34:11 and Zephaniah 2:14. This dual role highlights the cormorant both as part of God's dietary laws and as a symbol of desolation in prophetic imagery.
